_notes: Sensirion SHT3x (SHT30, SHT31, SHT35 - same protocol) at 0x44 (ADDR low) or 0x45 (ADDR high), the SHT4x addresses: 2-byte commands, where the SHT4x has 1-byte ones, so each record's detection fails on the other part. Detection: read the status register (0xF32D) and require a valid CRC - only the CRC: the datasheet's reserved status bits aren't reliably 0 (bits 5 and 6 read 1 in periodic mode, status 0x8070), and the read works in both single-shot and periodic mode. Init: break (0x3093) in case periodic measurement was left running, which would make single-shot commands fail. Poll: single-shot, high repeatability, no clock stretching (0x2400), 16 ms (max 15.5 ms), then read 6 bytes: T_MSB,T_LSB,T_CRC,RH_MSB,RH_LSB,RH_CRC. The sensor NACKs while measuring; the pause after the trigger bars the address, so a detection starting then is retried rather than failing, and the sensor is idle between polls.
